title: Paris 4 Ink Map
intro: The map on this page is the organizers' published ink map of PHerc. Paris 4; this Space streams it and reads the published mesh and CT, so every file below is linked at the Vesuvius Challenge open data, never copied here. The page's own API and its MCP server turn a map pixel into a winding and scan coordinates, cut crops, draw the spiral at one height, compare a place with the turns beside it and build a VC3D project. The Space is public and needs no account.

sources.title: MCP Server for Agents
sources.license: Vesuvius Challenge open data, CC BY-NC 4.0; the map and fit are the organizers'
sources.note: Streamable HTTP, no session, JSON replies. Seven tools: get_info, find_winding, point_info, crop_image (returns a PNG), cross_section (optionally with the CT slice), neighbor_turns (optionally with the three windows) and view_link.

sources.note: 956 by 56,913 nodes at 0.192 mm. This grid is already the fit rotated 180 degrees, as the map is (grid_transform in meta.json): map x = 2.5 times the column, map y = 2.5 times the row. Multiply the coordinates by 4 for 2.4 um voxels.
